project.title: SaaS System: DevOps Infrastructure
project.role: DevOps, Operations and Cloud Architect; Project Management

parentsummary.deliverables: Designed and implemented the DevOps infrastructure and CI/CD pipeline for the HighRoads V2 SaaS platform, modernizing the deployment model from a legacy hosted CMS to a fully cloud-native SaaS product with web GUI and API access, extending HIPAA and NIST-aligned access controls to the DevOps infrastructure layer.
parentsummary.outcomes: Introduced comprehensive DevOps and CI/CD automation practices that improved deployment frequency by 50% and eliminated manual deployment steps, enabling the engineering team to deliver the V2 SaaS platform with consistent, repeatable, and secure release processes.

challenge.summary: A traditional hosted customer facing CMS system was in production. Highroads was designing a new V2 system as a fully SaaS product with both web GUI access and customer available API access.

deliverables: Project Management using Agile methodologies, and hybrid reporting
Needs analysis, define requirements, and plan migration route
Architectural design and PoC implementation with modernization of infrastructure
Security Coordination and alignment to required Guidelines (HIPAA & NIST)
Implementation of IT Security and Cyber Protection Controls. Map to ISO:27001, NIST, and HIPAA
Extended the access control posture to the DevOps infrastructure layer
Led discovery sessions across the 15-person offshore engineering team, QA, and operations staff
Pre-migratory pen-testing and security reporting, load testing, and failure/high-availability testing
Documentation preparation for Operations staff, Development staff, and Management

outcomes: ✅ Introduced comprehensive DevOps and automation practices improving deployment frequency by 50% and eliminating manual deployment steps through CI/CD pipeline implementation
